articles.summary: NOX METALS has raised an $11.5M seed round led by Hyperion, with participation from Palmer Luckey, Y Combinator, and others, to build 100x more factories and revitalize America's industrial base.

articles.title: NOX METALS Is Now ISO 9001:2015 Certified
